Beginner.name: Clamshell
Beginner.line: Lie on your side and open your knees like a clam. Wakes up the hip muscles that keep knees out.

Sometimes.name: Band squat
Sometimes.line: The band pulls your knees in. Don't let it win.

Regular.name: Lateral band walk
Regular.line: Half-squat and walk sideways like a crab. If your hips burn, you're doing it right.

Beginner.name: Thoracic foam-roller stretch
Beginner.line: Drape your upper back over a foam roller and lean back. Undo the desk hunch.

Sometimes.name: Goblet squat
Sometimes.line: A weight at your chest is a counterbalance. A water bottle works too.

Regular.name: Wall-facing squat
Regular.line: Squat a hand's width from a wall. Lean forward and your nose finds out first.

Beginner.name: Box squat (high box)
Beginner.line: Touch the chair, stand up. The chair remembers your depth for you.

Sometimes.name: Box squat (low box)
Sometimes.line: One notch lower. Wherever you touch is today's depth.

Regular.name: Goblet squat 10-second bottom hold
Regular.line: Ten seconds at the bottom. The depth you hold is the depth you keep.

Beginner.name: Tempo squat 2s down, 1s hold
Beginner.line: Two down, one hold. The bounce clocks out here.

Sometimes.name: Tempo squat 3s down, 1s hold
Sometimes.line: Count one, two, three. Muscles work while the bounce rests.

Regular.name: Tempo squat 5s down, 3s hold
Regular.line: Five down, three hold. The longest eight seconds of your life.

Beginner.name: Bodyweight squat 3 x 15
Beginner.line: Your form is textbook. Now stack the reps.

Sometimes.name: Jump squat
Sometimes.line: Squat right, then up. Land quiet as a cat.

Regular.name: Bulgarian split squat
Regular.line: Back foot on a chair, one leg down. The Textbook's next chapter.

tips: Arms nowhere to go? Reach them forward. Your chest will follow.
Pick a spot 2–3 m ahead on the floor. That's your eyes' reserved seat.
Just tap the chair with your hips. Sitting down is cheating.
Push the floor apart with your feet. Your knees will head out.
Count "one, two" at the bottom. Two beats and the bounce is gone.

messages.footer: Form feedback, not medical advice. Videos are analyzed in memory and never stored.
messages.pain: Since you mentioned pain, we'll show your form feedback but skip exercise picks. Please check with a physical therapist or doctor first.
messages.upload_guide: Camera at hip height, 2–3 m away, head to toe in frame. Side view at exactly 90°. 4–5 reps, about 20 seconds. Stand fully up between reps. Record at 1080p 30 fps.
messages.sitting_rounded: Your chair has been training you to be The Phone Scroller. Time to fight back.
messages.how_it_works: Gemini 3.8 Flash screens every rep five times. Gemini 4 Argon re-checks only the reps where the votes split. You confirm anything still unclear.
messages.too_long: Please keep each clip under 30 seconds and 30 MB. Recording at 1080p 30 fps keeps files small.
